correctness.rationale: For n>=5, each 4-cycle is an elementary coordinate square, forcing a rooted automorphism to permute two incident opposite coordinate edge-pairs, with at most 8 options. Eight independent coordinate reflections/swaps exist and determine all vertices by straight continuation and square propagation. Thus rooted orbits are unordered circular distance pairs (a,b). Stable 1-WL colors distinguish all walk counts W_k(v)=(A^k)_{v,o} by induction, hence distance d, shortest path multiplicity g and predecessor number p by equitability. In Cartesian cyclic geometry d=a+b, p=1_{a>0}+1_{b>0}+epsilon(a)+epsilon(b), g=C(a+b,a)2^{epsilon(a)+epsilon(b)}, epsilon records even antipode. For fixed distance, binomial g increases strictly to the balanced a; p removes axes, and at even antipode p=2 distinguishes (0,h) by g=2 versus g>=h>=3 for both-positive pairs. Sign multiplicities then give class sizes and (h+1)(h+2)/2 classes. Independent signature injectivity check n=5..28 passed; source direct refinement, geodesic and graph-automorphism scripts inspected. All-order proof, not finite extrapolation.
